user.title: Vaultwarden
user.description: Address of your Vaultwarden instance, for example http://192.168.1.10 or https://vault.example.com. The admin token is optional: without it only reachability and the installed version are available, with it also users, organizations and the version comparison.

reauth_confirm.title: Vaultwarden admin token
reauth_confirm.description: The admin token for {url} is no longer accepted. Enter the current token.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Vaultwarden
reconfigure.description: Change the connection settings for {url}. Leave the admin token empty to keep the stored token.

error.rate_limited: Too many login attempts, try again in a few minutes.
error.admin_disabled: The admin backend is not enabled on this server (ADMIN_TOKEN is not set).
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

data_description.scan_interval_minutes: The version comparison is fetched at most once per hour regardless of this setting, because the server queries GitHub and NTP for it.
